claim: The Legislature convenes every year at noon on the second Monday of January
quote: The legislature shall assemble at the seat of government at twelve o'clock noon on the second Monday of January each year

claim: A bill not returned within five days of presentment (Sundays excepted) becomes law
quote: If any bill be not returned within five days after it shall have been presented to the governor (Sunday excepted)

claim: After final adjournment the governor has ten days (Sundays excepted) to file a veto, or the bill becomes law
quote: within ten days after such adjournment (Sundays excepted)

claim: Non-emergency acts take effect ninety days after the session closes
quote: ninety days after the close of the session of the legislature enacting such measure

claim: The primary is held on the second to last Tuesday in July
quote: A primary election shall be held on the second to last Tuesday in July

claim: The general election is the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of even-numbered years
quote: On the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of every even-numbered year, a general election shall be held

claim: Counties elect a sheriff, county attorney, recorder, treasurer, assessor, school superintendent and at least three supervisors, each for four years
quote: a sheriff, a county attorney, a recorder, a treasurer, an assessor, a superintendent of schools and at least three supervisors, each of whom shall be elected and hold his office for a term of four (4) years

claim: Supervisors are elected at the presidential general election
quote: who shall be elected at a general election at which the president of the United States is elected

claim: Since 2014, local candidate elections may be held only in even-numbered years, on the July and November dates
quote: may only be held on the following dates and only in even-numbered years

claim: A local first or primary election is held on the July date and the general or runoff on the November date
quote: the first election shall be held on this date, without regard to whether the political subdivision designates the election a primary election

claim: The even-year rule applies to cities, towns, counties, school districts and community college districts
quote: including a city, town, county, school district or community college district or any other district organized under state law but not including a special taxing district

claim: The Legislature reacted to the City of Tucson court ruling on charter city election dates by requiring consolidation after a turnout drop
quote: After consideration of the court's opinion in City of Tucson v. State

claim: A political subdivision whose off-cycle elections had a significant turnout decrease must move to statewide election dates
quote: A political subdivision shall hold its elections on a statewide election date if its previous elections on a nonstatewide election date resulted in a significant decrease in voter turnout

claim: Terms are lengthened when a place consolidates its election dates
quote: the terms of office for elected officials of the political subdivision shall be lengthened at the time of consolidation

claim: School board regular elections are held with the general election
quote: A regular election shall be held for each school district at the time and place, and in the manner, of general elections as provided in title 16

claim: School board members serve four-year terms
quote: the term of office for each member shall be four years from January 1 next following the member

claim: A school district board has three members unless enlarged
quote: There shall be three governing board members, except as otherwise provided by this section

claim: A union high school district board has five members
quote: In a union high school district, five members

claim: Fire district boards have three or five members
quote: the district board may consist of three or five members

claim: A voter registered with a recognized party gets only that party ballot
quote: the voter shall be given by the judge of election one ballot only of the party with which the voter is affiliated

claim: Independent and no-party voters choose one recognized party ballot in the primary
quote: the voter shall designate the ballot of only one of the political parties that is entitled to continued representation on the ballot

claim: Primary nominees are those with the most votes
quote: the person having the largest number of votes

claim: Supervisors are nominated at the primary
quote: one supervisor shall be elected from each district from among those nominated at the preceding primary election

claim: School board candidates appear without party designation
quote: without partisan or other designation except the title of the office

claim: City and town ballots may not show the source of a candidacy or party support
quote: a city or town shall not hold any election on candidates for which there is any indication on the ballot of the source of the candidacy or of the support of the candidate

claim: Nonpartisan offices appear in a separate nonpartisan section of the general election ballot
quote: Section Two Nonpartisan Ballot

claim: A city may provide that a candidate winning a majority at the primary is elected outright
quote: who receives a majority of all votes cast at that election for that office shall be declared elected to the office

claim: Council members elected by district are voted on only by that district
quote: only those voters who are qualified electors of the district, ward, precinct or other geographic designation are eligible to vote for that council member candidate

claim: County and local winners are those with the highest number of votes
quote: shall declare elected the person receiving the highest number of votes cast for each office to be filled by the electors of the county

claim: School board winners are those with the highest number of votes
quote: shall declare elected the person receiving the highest number of votes for each office to be filled

claim: Ties are decided by lot
quote: shall determine by lot

claim: A voter not registered with a recognized party may be nominated by petition instead of primary
quote: Any qualified elector who is not a registered member of a political party that is recognized pursuant to this title may be nominated as a candidate for public office otherwise than by primary election

claim: Independent petitions may be signed only by voters who did not sign a primary petition for the same office
quote: The petition shall be signed only by voters who have not signed the nomination petitions of a candidate for the office to be voted for at that primary election

claim: A candidate who failed to qualify for the primary on signatures cannot then use an independent petition
quote: the name of a candidate who has filed a nomination petition in the immediately preceding primary election and has failed to qualify as the result of an insufficient number of valid signatures

claim: Nonpartisan candidates file nomination papers and petitions
quote: Any person desiring to become a candidate at any nonpartisan election and to have the person's name printed on the official ballot

claim: Counties of 175,000 or more have five supervisors; smaller counties have three unless they vote to change
quote: In each county having a population of less than one hundred seventy-five thousand persons, a board of supervisors shall consist of three members

claim: Large counties have five supervisors
quote: There shall be in each county having a population of one hundred seventy-five thousand or more persons a board of supervisors consisting of five members

claim: Supervisors are nominated and elected by the voters of their own district
quote: They shall be nominated and elected by the qualified electors of their respective districts

claim: Counties are divided into three or five supervisorial districts
quote: divide the county into three or five supervisorial districts

claim: Statutory county officers include the clerk of the board, appointed; the treasurer is ex officio tax collector
quote: The county treasurer shall be ex officio tax collector

claim: A county of more than 500,000 people may elect a charter committee and adopt a charter
quote: The board of supervisors of any county with a population of more than five hundred thousand persons as determined by the most recent United States decennial or special census may call for an election to cause a charter committee to be elected

claim: A community of 1,500 or more may incorporate as a city or town
quote: the community incorporated as a city or town

claim: A town council has five or seven members depending on population at incorporation
quote: The common council of every town shall consist of five members if the population is fifteen hundred persons or less, or seven members if the population exceeds fifteen hundred persons

claim: Council members serve two-year terms by default
quote: Every member of the council shall hold the office for the term of two years

claim: By default the council chooses the mayor from among its members
quote: choose a mayor from among their number

claim: Voters may adopt a district system with council members elected by district and a directly elected mayor
quote: A mayor of the town shall be elected, who is the chief executive officer of the town

claim: A town of 3,000 or more may become a city by vote
quote: When a town has acquired a population of three thousand or over and the council shall by resolution so declare, the town may by majority vote of the qualified electors voting thereon assume a city organization

claim: A city of more than 3,500 may adopt a charter
quote: Any city containing, now or hereafter, a population of more than three thousand five hundred may frame a charter for its own government

claim: Charters must be consistent with state constitution and law
quote: consistent with, and subject to, the Constitution and the laws of the state

claim: A charter prevails over conflicting laws relating to cities
quote: the provisions of the charter shall prevail notwithstanding the conflict

claim: Municipal elections follow the law for county officer elections as nearly as possible
quote: shall conform to the provisions of law relating to the general election of county officers as nearly as possible

claim: The legislature declares consolidated election dates a matter of statewide concern that preempts charters
quote: This section preempts all local laws, ordinances and charter provisions to the contrary

claim: The legislature declares the nonpartisan city ballot and other election rules a matter of statewide concern
quote: The legislature finds that the conduct of elections described in this section is a matter of statewide concern

claim: The July date applies from 2026
quote: Beginning in 2026 and later, the second to last Tuesday in July
